blurb: Bear Ridge Paintball offers recreational paintball and GellyBall experiences for groups of all sizes and skill levels. They provide all rental gear, referees, and safety briefings, and welcome players as young as 10. Activities include open play, group packages, corporate team building events, and youth parties. Their outdoor facility features wooded and themed fields and can accommodate everything from casual outings to competitive team events.
